(produced by ``audit/runners/tool_call_compatibility.py --fast``) plus the
prior single-protocol matrix (``protocol_matrix.json``, when present) and
emits ``audit/results/model_tool_compatibility/fair_rebench_summary.json``.
Schema per model entry::
"model":           "phi4:latest",
"old_tool_pass":   0.4,       # openai_tools pass-rate (legacy harness)
"best_protocol":   "json_direct",
"fair_tool_pass":  1.0,       # best protocol pass-rate (fair harness)
"delta":           0.6,
"classification":  "PROMPT_BIAS_CONFIRMED",
"preferred_protocol_in_registry": "json_direct",
"registry_agrees": true,
Classifications (mutually exclusive, in priority order)::
QWEN_STILL_WINS         model_id contains "qwen" AND fair_tool_pass >= 0.9
PROMPT_BIAS_CONFIRMED   delta >= 0.4 AND best_protocol != "openai_tools"
PARSER_BIAS_CONFIRMED   delta >= 0.2 AND best_protocol == "openai_tools"
IMPROVED_WITH_TAGGED    best_protocol == "tagged" AND delta > 0.0
IMPROVED_WITH_JSON      best_protocol in {"json_direct","fenced_json",
"final_json_only",
"reasoning_then_json"}
AND delta > 0.0
TEXT_ONLY_RECOMMENDED   best_protocol == "text_baseline"
STILL_BAD_FOR_TOOLS     fair_tool_pass < 0.4
STABLE                  fallback (no significant change)
The script is read-only w.r.t. the runtime; it only writes the summary JSON
and prints a markdown table on stdout.
